playerPage.description: {team} · {pos} · Model xP for GW{gw1}–{gw2} (current FPL GW {gw0}).
playerPage.dataSourceFpl: FPL official — season totals, ICT, status, and prices from the live game data sync.
playerPage.dataSourceModel: FALEAGUE model — horizon xP and expected minutes use the same engine as the planner.
playerPage.dataSourceUnderstat: Understat — shot locations and xG for the shot map (matched to FPL ids).
playerPage.shotMapSubtitle: Where this player has shot — dot size ≈ xG, colour = outcome.

playerPage.shotMapTapHint: Tap a circle for minute, xG, and opponent.
playerPage.radarSubtitle: Form is the official FPL form figure vs peers. Other axes are season per-90 rates (÷ minutes × 90), each 0–100 vs the 95th percentile in the same position (min. minutes > 0). DefCon uses FPL defensive contribution.
playerPage.radarCaption: Shape vs strong peers: form plus per-90 output (goals, assists, xG, xA, defensive contribution) scaled to your position.
playerPage.radarCompareHint: Goals, assists, xG, xA, and DefCon are computed per 90 from season totals; each player is scored vs their own position’s p95.
playerPage.radarCompareNoHits: No other players match that search.
playerPage.radarComparePosNote: Different positions use different peer scales — good for shape, less for head-to-head raw stats.
playerPage.fixtureHint: Same projection engine as the planner’s Refresh xP (minutes, fixtures, rolling blend).

worldcupIndex.title: World Cup fantasy hub
worldcupIndex.description: Projected fixture difficulty, expected points, and hidden-gem scouting for the group stage. Stats blend FPL season data where linked; FDR and xP are FALEAGUE models — not official FIFA scoring.

worldcup.bracketSummary: Knockout results from live FIFA data. Winners advance only when both feeder matches are complete — later rounds stay blank until teams are confirmed.
worldcup.bracketSwipeHint: Swipe horizontally to see the full bracket tree.
worldcup.fdrSummary: Green = easier attack matchups. Tap a team on mobile for MD1–3 opponents.
worldcup.fdrDetail: FDR uses quintiles across all group-stage fixtures (1 = easiest). Desktop shows the full grid.
worldcup.xpSummary: Expected fantasy points for remaining group matchdays. Tap a player for per-MD breakdown.
worldcup.xpDetail: Totals sum upcoming fixtures only once a matchday is complete. Uses FIFA tournament stats when available, FDR, price, and ownership.
worldcup.scoutingSummary: Low-owned picks with strong projected xP in remaining group fixtures. Tap a card for club and season stats.
worldcup.scoutingDetail: Gem score blends remaining xP, FIFA % selected, and value. Uses WC tournament form from FIFA fantasy when synced. EPL-linked and spotlight-club players are excluded.
worldcup.scoutingMeta: Scanned {scanned} players · {spotlight} removed (EPL / spotlight clubs) · {popular} removed (high template %)
worldcup.scoutHiddenKillerHint: Forwards with upside and low template ownership.
worldcup.scoutUnsungHeroHint: Midfielders blending xA, form, and fixture relief.
worldcup.scoutSilentWallHint: Defenders with kind fixtures and under-the-radar profiles.
worldcup.scoutIndestructibleGateHint: Goalkeepers with stable fixture paths and differential pick rates.
worldcup.scoutEmpty: No gems in this bucket with current filters.
worldcup.matchesSummary: Fixtures, live scores, and goal scorers with assists. Tap a match for details; finished games include a text summary with listen-aloud.
worldcup.matchesDetail: Schedule, scores, and scorers sync from FIFA fantasy public feeds. Match summaries are generated from official FIFA data; listen-aloud uses Gemini neural voices (cached) with browser fallback.
worldcup.matchesDisclaimer: Match data from FIFA fantasy public feeds. Not an official FIFA or Opta product.
worldcup.tablesSummary: Standings for all 12 groups with W/D/L and points. Tap a team for results and squad.
worldcup.tablesDetail: Tables update from finished group-stage fixtures when scores sync from FIFA. Top scorers and assists use the World Cup fantasy player pool.
worldcup.tablesDisclaimer: Standings from finished fixtures only; tie-breakers follow FIFA group rules when fully synced.
worldcup.tablesLeaderboardEmpty: No goals or assists recorded yet.
worldcup.tablesSelectTeamHint: Tap a team row to see match results and squad.
worldcup.tablesNoPlayers: No squad data for this team.
worldcup.matchesNoStats: Team stats available after kickoff when configured.
worldcup.matchesPlayerStatsNone: No match stats found for this player.
worldcup.matchesPlayerStatsNotConfigured: Player match stats require API_FOOTBALL_KEY on the server.
worldcup.newsSummary: Opinion pieces, columns, and analysis from outlets worldwide. Tap a headline to read the full article on the publisher’s site.
worldcup.newsDetail: Aggregated from Google News editorial searches (US, UK, EU, Latin America, Asia-Pacific, Africa) plus The Guardian, BBC, Sky Sports, ESPN, and NY Times RSS feeds. Refreshes every 20 minutes. We link out only — we do not republish full articles.
worldcup.newsDisclaimer: Third-party headlines and links only; copyright remains with each publisher.
worldcup.newsEmpty: No articles for this filter. Try another region or turn off “Editorials only”.
worldcup.scoutFifaStats: Season stats from FIFA / FPL where available.
worldcup.radarNote: Radar axes scaled 0–100 relative to all World Cup fantasy players in this app.

fplInsights.hubDescription: Short tables from live FPL data — prep, picks, transfers, and models in one place.
fplInsights.premiumNote: Insights Pro unlocks transfer trends, differentials, and advanced models.
fplInsights.comingSoonBody: This insight is planned for Phase {phase} of the Insights rollout.
fplInsights.paywallBody: Upgrade for transfer momentum, differentials (≤5% owned), xG divergence, and more.

preseasonSignals.title: Pre-season
preseasonSignals.description: Friendly goals, assists, and line-ups before GW1.
preseasonSignals.intro: Aggregated from {n} finished pre-season matches. Use alongside prices and fixtures for GW1 squad picks.
preseasonSignals.matchNote: Line-ups available for a subset of friendlies; goals cover more matches.

recommendedSquad.title: Recommended squad
recommendedSquad.description: Pick a style and a few constraints — get three GW1 squad options in one go.
recommendedSquad.intro: One generation, three contrastive squads. Tweak in Squad Builder after you pick one. Change options and generate again for a new set.
recommendedSquad.regenHint: Want different options? Adjust options and generate again.
recommendedSquad.error: Could not build squads. Try fewer locks or different excludes.
recommendedSquad.emptyExclude: Popular names load here for quick exclude.
recommendedSquad.generatedOnce: Generated — pick a squad or change options to try again.

bestOfPosition.title: Best of Position
bestOfPosition.description: Exact-price rankings for GKP, DEF, MID and FWD — navigate the full budget series by position.
bestOfPosition.hubIntro: Pick a position and price point. Each page ranks every eligible player at that exact price by FALEAGUE xP, with average expected minutes, threat, DEFCON/90 and pre-season goals.
bestOfPosition.bandDescription: All £{price}m {position} ranked by projected xP, minutes, threat, DEFCON and pre-season form.
bestOfPosition.intro: We assessed {n} {position} priced at £{price}m. Ranked by FALEAGUE xP over the next {horizon} gameweeks — plus average expected minutes per gameweek, ICT threat, DEFCON/90 and pre-season goals.
bestOfPosition.assessed: {n} players assessed in this price band.

playerModal.shotMapEmpty: No shot-map data for this player yet.

setPieces.title: Set-pieces
setPieces.description: Penalty, free-kick, and corner takers by team.
setPieces.intro: Primary and backup set-piece takers from official FPL squad data. Primary = first choice; Backup = second. Lower-priority roles are hidden unless you show all orders.

defcon.title: Defcon
defcon.description: Season defensive contribution and underlying actions.
defcon.intro: Season defensive contribution (defcon) and CBI, recoveries, and tackles from FPL. Default min 450 minutes.

transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.description: This GW's buys, sells, and ownership movers.
transfers.intro: Gameweek {gw} transfer activity from live FPL data. Net = transfers in minus out.
transfers.empty: No transfer activity for these filters.

differentials.title: Differentials
differentials.description: Low-owned picks ranked within each position by next-5-GW xP.
differentials.intro: Ownership ≤{own}%. Top differentials in each position by projected xP over the next {horizon} gameweeks — GKP / DEF / MID / FWD are ranked separately.

fixtureSwing.title: Fixtures
fixtureSwing.description: Easiest and hardest FDR runs over the next 5–8 GWs.
fixtureSwing.intro: Average FDR from GW{fromGw} over the next {horizon} gameweeks. Lower = easier run for attackers.
fixtureSwing.empty: No fixture data for this horizon.

xgDivergence.title: xG gap
xgDivergence.description: FPL xG vs Understat vs actual goals — who's due a swing?
xgDivergence.intro: Season totals for all FPL players. Positive Δ = xG above actual goals (underperforming, may regress up).
xgDivergence.deltaHint: FPL Δ = FPL xG − goals. US Δ = Understat xG − goals. FPL−US = FPL xG − Understat xG.

xaDivergence.title: xA gap
xaDivergence.description: FPL xA vs Understat vs actual assists — who's due a swing?
xaDivergence.intro: Season totals for all FPL players. Positive Δ = xA above actual assists (underperforming, may regress up).
xaDivergence.deltaHint: FPL Δ = FPL xA − assists. US Δ = Understat xA − assists. FPL−US = FPL xA − Understat xA.

priceChanges.title: Prices
priceChanges.description: Risers and fallers from GW price history.
priceChanges.intro: Price moves detected from per-GW FPL values through GW{gw}. Net change is season-to-date.
priceChanges.empty: No price changes recorded yet this season.

priceForecast.title: Price watch
priceForecast.description: Who is closest to a rise or fall tonight, based on this GW's net transfers.
priceForecast.intro: Through GW{gw}. Community model: a £0.1 move often needs net transfers around 10% of current owners (with a volume floor). FPL's algorithm is unpublished — treat this as a caution, not a guarantee. Prices usually tick around 01:30–02:30 UK (08:30–09:30 Shanghai).
priceForecast.sourceDb: Live FPL unavailable — showing last synced snapshot.
priceForecast.empty: Nobody is close to the threshold yet — transfers are quiet, or data has not refreshed.

historical.title: Historical
historical.description: Filter and compare FPL stats across seasons and GWs.

xpAccuracy.title: xP model
xpAccuracy.description: How our xP projections matched actual GW points.
xpAccuracy.intro: Historical replay: xP projected before each GW using only prior data, compared to actual points for players with minutes. Last five finished gameweeks.
xpAccuracy.empty: No finished gameweeks with synced stats yet — check back after GW1 completes.

fplHistorical.note: Stats are summed across the selected gameweek range. Seasons 2016/17–2025/26 come from archived vaastav data; the current campaign is synced live from FPL. Run the historical backfill job after migration 0022 to populate older seasons.
